text:
olivia: kicking off three-zone warmup for v3.2.0 rollout. plan is US -> EU -> APAC. windows below, need capacity + ratecap signoff and pinning plan.

olivia: windows (PT): US 06:00-08:00, EU 14:00-16:00, APAC 00:00-02:00. canaries: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with holdpoints. anyone object to order?

sam: looks good. who has final say on regional rate caps? we should prevent a global burst from APAC during its window when EU still warm.

deploy-ops: recommend regional static caps during rollout. default fallback policy is to route to v3.1.5-quant if capacity signal triggers. we also want version pinning for EU until EU warmpool > 70% cushion for 30m.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] job_id=rb-2419753200, model=v3.2.0, rollout=threezone, canary=5%, hold=15m. comments=regional pin + fallback configured.

kevin: did quick warmup smoke. warm pool counts: US warmed 30 nodes (expected cushion ~35%), EU pre-warm started 12/40 (est cushion ~20%), APAC warm plan queued. will add more warm nodes if EU <25% cushion before canary.

maria: ratecap proposal:
```
routes:
  - region: US
    max_rps: 12000
  - region: EU
    max_rps: 9000
  - region: APAC
    max_rps: 6000
```
This is conservative but prevents noisy-neighbor spikes. we can bump after 1h stable.

ashley: agree with stagger. suggest ramp steps: 5% (15m), 20% (30m), 50% (30m), 100% (auto if no holds tripped). holdpoint checks: error_rate, p95 latency, gpu mem. if any threshold exceeded, rollback to previous pinned version in that region.

deploy-ops: rollback triggers (operational):
- error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m
- p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for 10m OR p95 > 800ms
- GPU memory pressure > 92% or OOMs observed
On trigger: immediate route pin to last-stable (v3.1.5) for affected region, page oncall.

sam: for EU pin, we'll create a version alias `prod-eu` pinned to v3.2.0-eu during rollout and only unpin after 30m stable at target cushion. deploy-ops, can you create alias and ensure analytics tag so we can slice traffic metrics?

deploy-ops: done. alias `prod-eu` created and tagged with rollout_id=2419753200. analytics hook enabled.

kevin: starting US canary now at 06:05 PT: 5%. monitor dashboard: token p50=85ms, p95=240ms, error_rate=0.3%, warmpool cushion 33%. holding 15m.

deploy-bot: [canary update] job_id=rb-2419753200 progress=US 5% -> stable at 06:20 PT. metrics_ok=true.

maria: EU warmpool still low, please hold EU canary until cushion >=25%. also request temporary stricter ratecap for EU ingress during first 30m: set EU max_rps to 7k instead of 9k.

ashley: updated rollout plan: EU canary deferred until warmpool >=25% or manual override from infra leads. APAC stays queued after EU completes.

kevin: accepted. increasing EU warm nodes now +10, ETA 12m.

deploy-ops: note on fallback: we will use weighted routing to send 100% traffic to fallback variant (v3.1.5-quant) for any region that trips rollback triggers. fallback is pre-warmed in each region.

olivia: good catch on analytics. please attach the eval prompt set to the rollout so we can run live-quality checks during canaries (quick sanity eval: generation quality + hallucination rate).

deploy-ops: eval hook attached to rollout_id=2419753200. alert thresholds: hallucination delta > 5% over baseline -> auto-fail canary.

maria: quick ask — release notes link? need to surface known regressions and config changes to support teams.

deploy-ops: release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2419753200 (includes rollback criteria, pinning, ratecap config, fallback variant). added to calendar change window.

olivia: final check: everyone clear on handoff to oncall after EU completes? oncall, you'll inherit the rollout and override pins if stable.

sam: acknowledged. oncall, if EU holds >2h or repeated holds at different steps, escalate to eng-release lead.

deploy-bot: [final] rollout snapshot: US=complete, EU=canary pending warmpool, APAC=queued. actions: keep EU pin until stable, maintain regional ratecaps, fallback enabled.

olivia: thanks team — updating the runbook with these negotiated caps and rollback rules. will post final summary in #all-hands and tag customer-success for messaging. :thumbsup:
